about: Prepared foods people log often, under the names they search for. Each is tied to one USDA food or a recipe of USDA foods; see README.md.

foods.name: Basmati rice, white, cooked, unsalted
foods.basis: USDA SR Legacy 169757: "Rice, white, long-grain, regular, unenriched, cooked without salt". Basmati and jasmine are long-grain white rices; USDA has no variety-specific analysis, so this uses USDA long-grain white rice (unenriched, as most imported basmati/jasmine is).

foods.name: Overnight oats with milk and Greek yogurt

servings.label: 1 jar (1/2 cup oats, 1/2 cup 2% milk, 1/2 cup nonfat Greek yogurt)

foods.basis: Recipe: USDA Foundation Foods 2346396: "Oats, whole grain, rolled, old fashioned" 40 g; USDA FNDDS 2021-2023 2705386: "Milk, reduced fat (2%)" 122 g; USDA FNDDS 2021-2023 2705424: "Yogurt, Greek, nonfat milk, plain" 113 g. No cooking, so no weight change.
